gloss: double-talk; duplicity; speaking with a forked tongue

definitions.gloss: double-talk; duplicity; speaking with a forked tongue
definitions.explanation: Saying contradictory things to different people, or contradicting one's own earlier words; deceitful, two-faced speech.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{二枚舌|にまいじた}だ。
{二枚舌|にまいじた}を{使|つか}う{人|ひと}は{信用|しんよう}できない。
examples.english: You can't trust someone who talks out of both sides of their mouth.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}によって{言|い}うことを{変|か}える{二枚舌|にまいじた}な{態度|たいど}に{腹|はら}が{立|た}った。
examples.english: I was angry at his two-faced way of changing what he said depending on the listener.

notes:
Literally 'two tongues.' Almost always used with {使|つか}う in the set phrase {二枚舌|にまいじた}を{使|つか}う (to engage in double-talk).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二枚舌|にまいじた}を{使|つか}う: to say two different things; to be deceitful

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {裏表|うらおもて}がある: to be two-faced — having a hidden side different from the public one
- うそつき: a liar — the plain word for someone who tells untruths
